topPRs.title: Fix op-signer release builds without CGO
topPRs.author: Inphi
topPRs.body:
The op-signer GoReleaser job fails when cross-compiling with CGO disabled because the KMS signature conversion calls `secp256k1.VerifySignature` and `secp256k1.RecoverPubkey`, which are only available with CGO. This reproduces the [v1.7.0-rc.1 release failure](https://circleci.com/gh/ethereum-optimism/infra/14389).

Use go-ethereum's `crypto.VerifySignature` and `crypto.Ecrecover` so signature verification and recovery work in both build modes. CGO-enabled builds continue using the same C-backed implementation. The build settings are unchanged.

Add a signer-only `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./...` check to the regular CircleCI test job so this compilation failure is caught before a release. Keep the signing tests consistent with the crypto APIs and compare curve parameters and serialized public keys so the same assertions work with both curve implementations.

Local validation:

- Normal `go test ./...` passed.
- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -ldflags="-checklinkname=0" ./...` passed.
- The CGO-disabled build check passed.
- CGO-disabled builds passed for all configured release targets: linux/amd64, windows/amd64, darwin/amd64, and darwin/arm64.

The release packaging and publishing steps were not run locally.

ref: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/core-team/issues/3040
